consequence.statement: Adding the `enabled` value is additive. It lets cert-manager be toggled when used as a chart dependency, and an operator does not need to do anything.

assertion.statement: The cert-manager Helm chart now accepts an `enabled` value, so a parent chart can toggle cert-manager when it is used as a dependency.
